tasks.taskIntent: Recover Electron E2E firstWindow startup when the isolated run root cannot initialize userData on a low-integrity checkout.

sources.title: Electron E2E run-root recovery
sources.content: Electron E2E firstWindow startup can fail when Playwright overrides CLAWX_E2E_RUN_ROOT and the low-integrity checkout cannot write to the caller run root. The fixture must create a unique verse-claw-e2e-run-* child directory under the caller-provided base, and startup tracing must remain opt-in.

sources.title: SEKB confirm provenance
sources.content: Confirmed SEKB principles must preserve session and trajectory provenance. Confirm-and-save remains the only durable principle write path and shadow writes are advisory.

sources.title: DCS catalog drift
sources.content: Catalog entries must record executor sites so landed-unwired components are detected mechanically. A catalog claim without a production call site is stale.

sources.title: SEKB confirm provenance
sources.content: SEKB confirm-and-save must preserve provenance and may optionally write an experience-shadow journal. The runtime config leaf stays observability-only and the durable BlockStore write remains authoritative.

sources.title: DCS catalog drift
sources.content: Catalog drift is detected by executor sites, not by source presence alone.

tasks.taskIntent: Eliminate landed-unwired components by wiring each developed component into a real production development flow and enforcing catalog executor sites.

sources.content: A component is wired only when the catalog records a production executor site. Landed-unwired components are counted and must be reduced to zero with file:line evidence.
